notice: Editorial introductions for eight verified sessions. The full catalog is generated separately from the public Ignite snapshot.

sessions.title: Voice agents in Microsoft Foundry: Prototype to production in 45 mins
sessions.summary: Take your voice-agent work from an early prototype toward production. Explore the application journey with Microsoft Foundry, with a focus on practical voice experiences.
sessions.takeaway: A useful pick if you are building conversational products, contact-center experiences, or a voice-first application.

sessions.title: How much should you own? Choosing the right agent architecture
sessions.summary: How much of your agent stack should your team own? Start with the architecture decisions behind an agent application and consider where managed services fit.
sessions.takeaway: A useful starting point for developers and architects deciding how to structure an agent project.

sessions.title: Content-aware agents with Content Understanding/Document Intelligence
sessions.summary: Connect agents with the business content they need to understand. Explore the role of Content Understanding and Document Intelligence in content-aware applications.
sessions.takeaway: Consider this session if your agents work with documents, forms, or other business content.

sessions.title: From open weights to workload: Operationalizing at enterprise scale
sessions.summary: Move the conversation from model selection to enterprise workloads. Look at the operational questions involved in taking open-weight models to scale.
sessions.takeaway: A relevant choice for platform teams and engineers responsible for operating model-backed applications.

sessions.title: How SThree is reimagining recruitment with human-led AI
sessions.summary: Explore SThree's approach to putting AI alongside recruitment consultants rather than replacing their judgment. The discussion connects agent design with the relationship-building work people want more time for.
sessions.takeaway: For leaders and builders exploring human-in-the-loop AI and practical business transformation.

sessions.title: Build your self-improving AI Platform with Microsoft Foundry
sessions.summary: Connect evaluation, observability and optimization into a continuous improvement loop. Consider how a governed AI platform can adapt to changing customer context while balancing quality, cost and reliability.
sessions.takeaway: For platform engineers designing the feedback loop around production AI applications.

sessions.title: Token economics: Get more from your production AI budget
sessions.summary: Look at the choices behind a production AI budget: models, inference tiers, caching, routing and capacity handling. Customer examples connect those decisions to the trade-offs between cost, quality and latency.
sessions.takeaway: For teams looking to make production AI spending more intentional and measurable.

sessions.title: Trust at scale: Governance lessons from Microsoft
sessions.summary: Explore how governance, safety and accountability become part of operating AI at scale. Learn from Microsoft's approach to embedding risk-based controls and ongoing monitoring into AI systems.
sessions.takeaway: For attendees focused on responsible AI, governance, security and enterprise adoption.
